leak: Entry sized off provably stale bar

decision_record.transfer: Faber's edge is holding an ETF above its 210-session average; the comparison only means something against the latest close -- a stale last bar can show price above an average the current market has already broken.
decision_record.comparison: Control: enter whenever the last bar closes above the 210 SMA, regardless of bar age. Treatment: refuse the entry when the last bar is >4 calendar days before the session. Exits untouched (an owned position's trend exit is never blocked by this gate).
decision_record.mechanism: s_mn_faber required 210 bars but never checked the last bar's date; stale history (producer lag) produced trend entries priced off a weeks-old close.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture: 210 SPY bars, last close $110 > SMA ~$100.05, last bar 2026-10-01 vs session 2026-10-23 -> ON 0 entries + paired journal; OFF 1 entry qty 5; fresh last bar 2026-10-23 -> ON 1 entry.
